name: AAPP 2027 Annual Meeting
organizer: American Association of Psychiatric Pharmacists (AAPP, formerly CPNP)
description: The American Association of Psychiatric Pharmacists, formerly the College of Psychiatric and Neurologic Pharmacists, holds its 2027 annual meeting at The Galt House Hotel in Louisville, Kentucky, from April 4 to 7, 2027. The organization renamed itself from CPNP to AAPP in 2022 and continues to use the name Annual Meeting for this event.

Treat as a low-confidence placeholder only.
